accounts_owner_matches_kind.name: accounts_owner_matches_kind
accounts_owner_matches_kind.value: ("accounts"."kind" in ('client', 'partner') and "accounts"."owner_id" is not null) or ("accounts"."kind" in ('revenue', 'payable', 'settlement') and "accounts"."owner_id" is null)

operators_mvno_has_host.name: operators_mvno_has_host
operators_mvno_has_host.value: ("operators"."is_mvno" = false and "operators"."host_operator_id" is null) or ("operators"."is_mvno" = true and "operators"."host_operator_id" is not null)

users_totp_confirmed_requires_secret.name: users_totp_confirmed_requires_secret
users_totp_confirmed_requires_secret.value: "users"."totp_confirmed_at" is null or "users"."totp_secret" is not null
